about: Dated obligations, curated by hand from the cited source. Add an entry only after reading the source. status.mjs computes passed, within 60 days and upcoming.

deadlines.title: Personal developer accounts created after this date must run a closed test with at least 12 testers opted in for 14 days before applying for production
deadlines.note: Ongoing requirement. Accounts created before this date are not covered.

deadlines.title: New apps and app updates must target Android 16 (API level 36) or higher
Extension date for requests to update target API level, as stated on the target API page
deadlines.note: Only relevant to apps still on an older target. Ours is not.

deadlines.title: All Play packages must be registered for Android developer verification; unregistered apps are removed from Play
deadlines.note: Passed. New packages need the developer identity verified and the signing key certificate registered before the first upload.

deadlines.title: Policy update effective: Local Network Permission and Manage Contacts Permission restrictions; developers have at least 30 days to comply
End of the minimum 30-day compliance window for the 2026-10-29 update (calculated)
deadlines.note: Calculated as 30 days after 2026-10-29; the page says "at least 30 days".

deadlines.title: Changes take effect for location, SMS and call log, foreground-service (geofencing) and contacts permission policies
deadlines.note: Our app declares only internet and biometric permissions (checked 2026-10-30).

deadlines.title: Bad-behavior and optimization thresholds begin (page says "from February 2027")
deadlines.note: The day is not stated; 1 February is a planning placeholder.

deadlines.title: Apps must support zero-tap sign-in restore credentials (page says "from April 2027")
deadlines.note: The day is not stated; 1 April is a planning placeholder.

deadlines.title: Manage Contacts permission restrictions take effect
